acceptance: Header parity test extended to the Astro header and green
axe: zero serious/critical on a docs page, blog post and landing at desktop and 390px widths
Theme toggle persists via benchbox:theme and matches explorer behaviour
Pagefind returns a docs term and a blog title; results section is absent or empty until astro-site-61
Starlight overrides used are listed; none patch Starlight internals
description:
Build the shell in the layout variant chosen at G1 (default: Starlight docs inside a custom shell).

Components:
- header: Docs, Blog, Results, GitHub, search, theme toggle
- footer
- docs layout: sidebar, breadcrumbs, on-page TOC, edit link
- blog layout

The header must match the current header contract (results-explorer/src headerContract.ts and tests/unit/test_site_header_parity.py), and is extracted as a shared component so the Explorer renders the same shell (see astro-site-40).

The sidebar comes from config that the converter derives from toctrees.

Search: Pagefind indexes docs and blog HTML only. The search UI reserves a separate "Results" section. It stays empty until astro-site-61 supplies generated result summaries; Pagefind never indexes DuckDB-WASM content.

Use real <a>/<button> elements, keep 44px touch targets, and make the layout work at phone width.
